usage: Agents: pick exactly ONE dna. Load only that file. Never load all.

dnas.name: Acid Rave
dnas.vibe: Black room, acid lime, type at maximum volume. Flyers, not landing pages.

dnas.name: Alpine After Dark
dnas.vibe: Night at altitude: deep indigo snowfields, a single headlamp amber, constellations plotted over ridgelines.

dnas.name: Alpine Ledger
dnas.vibe: A mountaineering logbook: kraft paper, rubber stamps, rope and knot motifs, stamped entries.

dnas.name: Aperitivo Italian
dnas.vibe: Golden hour at a Milan bar, every night. Campari red, bitter orange, and typography you can taste.

dnas.name: Apotheke
dnas.vibe: Amber bottles in a row, labels in careful Latin, the mortar never quite clean. Remedies, measured twice.

dnas.name: Arctic Field
dnas.vibe: Expedition research: ice white, glacier blue, instrument precision — data you can trust at −30°.

dnas.name: Art Deco Luxe
dnas.vibe: 1920s geometric glamour: black lacquer, gold leaf, sunburst symmetry. A jazz-age ballroom rendered as a website.

dnas.name: Art Nouveau Whiplash
dnas.vibe: Mucha posters and ironwork: organic curves, jewel tones, every frame an ornament.

dnas.name: Barbershop Pole
dnas.vibe: Vitrolite tile, spinning stripes, the honest smell of bay rum. Walk-ins welcome, appointments kept.

dnas.name: Bauhaus Primary
dnas.vibe: Functional geometry: red, yellow, blue on off-white. A workshop poster that refuses to decorate.

dnas.name: Bazaar Spice
dnas.vibe: Spice-market maximalism: turmeric dust in the air, paprika-red textiles, patterned awnings, and stalls stacked to the sky.

dnas.name: Bike Repair
dnas.vibe: Workbench hours: grease under the nails, a truing stand that never lies, and the quiet pride of a drivetrain that finally shifts clean.

dnas.name: Blueprint Tech
dnas.vibe: Cyanotype schematics: deep blueprint blue, white line work, everything labeled.

dnas.name: Botanical Lab
dnas.vibe: A greenhouse full of specimens: deep green, pressed-plant delicacy, Latin on every label.

dnas.name: Cassette J-Card
dnas.vibe: Photocopied liner notes, hand-labeled spines, tracklists typed with a tired ribbon. Side A still hits harder.

dnas.name: Chalkboard Cafe
dnas.vibe: A cafe menu board in chalk: slate black, hand-lettered specials, doodled borders.

dnas.name: Circus Poster
dnas.vibe: Wood type and starbursts: a 1910 big-top bill shouted in deep red and gold.

dnas.name: Concrete Poem
dnas.vibe: Typographic art: words arranged as shapes on the page — ink, paper, and the architecture of language.

dnas.name: Constructivist Red
dnas.vibe: Propaganda poster as interface: red and black diagonals, type that shouts from a wall.

dnas.name: Corner Deli
dnas.vibe: Daytime awning: the slicer is already warm, the ticket rail is full by eleven, and everybody's order is remembered whether they want it to be or not.

dnas.name: Cottage Warm
dnas.vibe: Cozy domestic: cream, checks, garden warmth. The website equivalent of someone offering you tea.

dnas.name: Cyberpunk Noir
dnas.vibe: Rain-slicked neon city: near-black, electric pink and cyan, glitch under the surface. Dense, alert, humming.

dnas.name: Dark Luxe
dnas.vibe: Near-black, champagne accents, whisper-thin serif. Expensive by restraint.

dnas.name: De Stijl Grid
dnas.vibe: Mondrian's canvas as a website: primary blocks, black grids, white doing the heavy lifting.

dnas.name: Desert Modern
dnas.vibe: Palm Springs at 10am: shade, breeze-block shadows, a pool doing all the talking.

dnas.name: Diary Zine
dnas.vibe: Photocopied punk zine: cut-and-paste ransom type, staples through the gutter, marker underlines, and ink that ran in the rain.

dnas.name: Docs Solar
dnas.vibe: Warm documentation, amber accents, serif readability. Docs people actually enjoy reading.

dnas.name: Drive-In Theater
dnas.vibe: Dusk at the lot: the sky goes flat indigo, the marquee flickers on, and the second feature starts whether you are back from the snack bar or not.

dnas.name: Editorial Serif
dnas.vibe: Warm paper, oversized serif, hairline rules. A literary magazine that happens to be a website.

dnas.name: Farmers Almanac
dnas.vibe: Print reference craft: aged paper, inked tables, the moon doing the scheduling. Weather wisdom set by hand, one season at a time.

dnas.name: Fishing Tackle
dnas.vibe: Retail wall craft: pegboard, price guns, and a thousand small decisions behind glass. The lure wall is organized by someone who takes this very seriously.

dnas.name: Glass Calm
dnas.vibe: Frosted surfaces over pastel light. Weather-app serenity as a design language.

dnas.name: Gothic Editorial
dnas.vibe: Dark academia: candlelit paper, blackletter accents used sparingly, scholarly and brooding. A library after hours.

dnas.name: Greenhouse Glass
dnas.vibe: A Victorian glasshouse: black iron ribs arcing overhead, condensation beading on the panes, fern greens breathing in the humidity.

dnas.name: Greenmarket Dawn
dnas.vibe: 6am at the farmers market: dew on greens, kraft paper, chalked price tags.

dnas.name: Harbor Fog
dnas.vibe: Maritime fog: muted grays, signal red, foghorn typography. The lighthouse keeps its own hours.

dnas.name: Industrial Brutalist
dnas.vibe: Exposed structure, safety orange, condensed type. A factory that ships software.

dnas.name: Ink-Wash Sumi
dnas.vibe: Brush, ink, rice paper: monochrome gestures and the confidence to leave space alone.

dnas.name: Italian Futurist
dnas.vibe: Italian futurism: speed lines, dynamism, chrome and red. A racing poster that refuses to sit still.

dnas.name: Jazz Blue Note
dnas.vibe: Mid-century jazz sleeve art: duotone photography, smoky blue, bold condensed sans, liner-note typography.

dnas.name: Kawaii Pixel
dnas.vibe: Sticker-sheet joy: pastel pixels, chunky hearts, everything huggable at 8x scale.

dnas.name: Lab Notebook
dnas.vibe: A scientist's field notebook: graph-paper grids, photos held down with masking tape, red-pen marginalia, and a coffee ring on page 47.

dnas.name: Laboratory Clean
dnas.vibe: A calibrated instrument, not a landing page: sterile white, spec tables, every label measured.

dnas.name: Laundromat Neon
dnas.vibe: Open 24 hours: humming fluorescents over white tile, mint and chrome at 3am.

dnas.name: Library Oak
dnas.vibe: Leather and brass: card catalogs, reading lamps, the hush of old oak stacks.

dnas.name: Locksmith Shop
dnas.vibe: Brass and steel: the key machine hums, the ticket book never lies, and every key leaves with a story the customer almost tells you.

dnas.name: Ma (Japanese Minimal)
dnas.vibe: Rice paper, ink black, vast emptiness used on purpose. Ma — the beauty of negative space.

dnas.name: Matchbook Cover
dnas.vibe: Two inches of advertising you kept in your pocket. Strike anywhere, remember everything.

dnas.name: Memphis Milano
dnas.vibe: 80s postmodern play: squiggles, terrazzo, pastel-neon clashes. Deliberate kitsch that refuses to apologize.

dnas.name: Midnight Railway
dnas.vibe: The night train platform: deep navy, brass fittings, timetables set with total confidence.

dnas.name: Museum Placard
dnas.vibe: Gallery walls and catalog restraint: a placard, a number, and nothing you don't need.

dnas.name: Neo-Brutalist Pop
dnas.vibe: Thick borders, hard shadows, sticker colors. Playful but engineered.

dnas.name: Neon Diner
dnas.vibe: 1950s American diner: chrome, cherry red, teal vinyl. The OPEN sign is always on.

dnas.name: Newsroom Wire
dnas.vibe: The copy desk at 2am: teletype clatter, urgent red wire alerts, ink on newsprint.

dnas.name: Night Market
dnas.vibe: Strings of lanterns over wet pavement, hand-painted stall signs, steam off the grill. Eat first, ask questions later.

dnas.name: Nordic Noir
dnas.vibe: Overcast crime scene at noon. Desaturated slate, hard facts, no comfort.

dnas.name: Observatory Star
dnas.vibe: A working astronomical observatory as a website: deep-space navy, brass instrument dials, hand-plotted star charts, and the hush of the dome at 2am.

dnas.name: Origami Fold
dnas.vibe: Paper-fold geometry: crisp creases, washi texture, single-sheet discipline. Nothing is added; everything is folded.

dnas.name: Paris Metro
dnas.vibe: Art Nouveau metro wayfinding: Guimard curves, navy enamel, gold lettering. Mind the gap, in style.

dnas.name: Parisian Chic
dnas.vibe: Haute couture polish: black, white, and cream with a high-contrast Didot-style serif and atelier restraint.

dnas.name: Pixel Arcade
dnas.vibe: Insert coin. Dark cabinet, neon scoreboards, chunky pixels you can almost bite.

dnas.name: Pixel Garden
dnas.vibe: A cozy 8-bit gardening sim as a website: tilled soil rows, sprout-green pixels, and a blocky sun that rises on scroll.

dnas.name: Pop-Art Halftone
dnas.vibe: Ben-Day dots, thick black outlines, and color turned up until it shouts.

dnas.name: Postage Stamp
dnas.vibe: Engraved portraits the size of a thumbnail, perforated edges, gum on the back. Mail still moves at the speed of care.

dnas.name: Postcard Rack
dnas.vibe: Tourist ephemera: sun-faded ink, a spinning rack of somewhere-elses, and handwriting on the back that says the weather is perfect.

dnas.name: Retro Terminal
dnas.vibe: Phosphor green on black, scanlines, amber warnings. The machine is the message.

dnas.name: Risograph Grain
dnas.vibe: Misregistered zine ink on cream: teal over pink, grain you can feel, handmade edges.

dnas.name: Roadside Motel
dnas.vibe: Highway typography: the sign is taller than the building, the pool is closed, and the vacancy light has been on since 1962 and it is still on.

dnas.name: Sahara Ochre
dnas.vibe: Artisanal earth: terracotta, clay, and spice tones with handmade texture — the craft market, not the museum.

dnas.name: Sauna Cedar
dnas.vibe: Cedar heat and steam: a Finnish loyly rendered in dark wood and glowing ember.

dnas.name: Scandi Calm
dnas.vibe: Hygge minimalism: warm whites, pale wood tones, quiet functionality. Nothing shouts; everything breathes.

dnas.name: Seed Packet
dnas.vibe: Engraved print ephemera: kraft paper, copperplate vegetables, and planting instructions set like they matter — because they do.

dnas.name: Sewing Pattern
dnas.vibe: Tissue thin as breath, dashed lines that mean cut here, notches that have to match. Measure twice, sew once.

dnas.name: Soft Minimal
dnas.vibe: Off-white calm, iris accent, spring motion. The Linear/Notion register, done right.

dnas.name: Stadium Floodlight
dnas.vibe: Concrete bowl at 9pm: floodlights on, turf glowing, everything else shadow.

dnas.name: Storybook Watercolor
dnas.vibe: A children's picture book: washed paper, ink outlines, hand-lettered display. Read me like it's bedtime.

dnas.name: Surf Shack
dnas.vibe: Sun-bleached and hand-painted: faded teal, warm sand, and signage you can tell a person made.

dnas.name: Swimming Pool
dnas.vibe: Chlorinated summer: pale water, hot concrete, the lifeguard's red stand. Everything smells like sunscreen and the deep end is always colder than you remember.

dnas.name: Swiss Airline
dnas.vibe: Mid-century airline identity: timetable grids, the red arrow, Helvetica-like order. Departures on time, forever.

dnas.name: Swiss Poster
dnas.vibe: Bold poster art: oversized type AS the image, flat color blocks, one accent. Shout it from the wall.

dnas.name: Swiss Rational
dnas.vibe: Strict grid, black on white, one red. Information architecture as aesthetic.

dnas.name: Ticket Stub
dnas.vibe: Admit one. The paper left in your pocket after the lights came up. Keep it — you'll want the date.

dnas.name: Tokyo Kissaten
dnas.vibe: Showa-era Japanese coffee house: dark walnut, worn velvet booths, low brass lamps, and the slow pour of a siphon brewer.

dnas.name: Tokyo Neon
dnas.vibe: Electric signage culture: hot pink and cyan on black, vertical accents, the glow of a Shinjuku side street.

dnas.name: Transit Swiss
dnas.vibe: Wayfinding systems: line colors, station dots, route-map clarity — designed to be read at a sprint.

dnas.name: Tropical Brutalism
dnas.vibe: Brazilian concrete breathing: raw gray mass, lush green, hard sunlight and deep shadow.

dnas.name: Typewriter Repair
dnas.vibe: Springs, escapements, and ribbon tins spread across the bench. Every machine leaves typing straighter than it came.

dnas.name: Ukiyo-e Print
dnas.vibe: Japanese woodblock print: Prussian blue, vermillion, wave compositions. The floating world, keyed and registered.

dnas.name: Vaporwave Sunset
dnas.vibe: Retro-futurist sunset grids in peach, coral, and teal. A chrome sun that never quite sets.

dnas.name: Vinyl Crate
dnas.vibe: A beloved record store: sleeve grids, kraft dividers, sticker prices — analog warmth with crate-digger discipline.

dnas.name: Weather Station
dnas.vibe: Brass dials, aneroid needles, the logbook filled at 0600 Zulu. The sky, measured honestly.

dnas.name: Y2K Chrome
dnas.vibe: Liquid metal, iridescent gradients, bubbly type. The future as imagined in 1999.
